summary: Wrote a five-phase plan for the sapience extension at agent-system/extensions/sapience/: phase 1 scaffolds the manifest plus settings-fragment.json carrying the four MCP write-tool grants (gap 1, the blocker), phase 2 writes EXTENSION.md with the postflight sapience_wrapup instruction (gap 2), phase 3 writes five context/project/sapience/ notes including gap 3's documented resolution, phase 4 writes schema-conformant index-entries.json, phase 5 activates, redeploys and runs the full gate set. The plan deliberately drops one dispatch-named deliverable, scripts/sapience-context.sh, after independently re-verifying the research's refutation in skill-base.sh: a task_type-less extension's lifecycle hook is structurally unreachable for every task of every type, so the hook would ship as dead code. Gap 1 was re-derived live during authoring (7 read-only grants in dotfiles, 0 in .claude/settings.local.json) and plan authoring also surfaced two index-schema constraints the research missed (the on_demand:true marker and the forbidden description/tags/tier keys), now concrete phase-4 items.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan: manifest plus permission grants, EXTENSION.md wrapup instruction, domain notes, index entries, activate/redeploy/verify. 4.25h, waves [[1],[2,3],[4],[5]].
